YAJIE CUI received the B.S. degree in computer science and technology from Northeastern Uni- versity, Shenyang, China, in 2018, and the M.S. degree in computer science and technology from Tianjin University, Tianjin, China, in 2021. Since 2021, she has been an Algorithm Engineer in deep learning with the AI Innovation and Appli- cation Center, China Unicom Digital Technology Company Ltd., Beijing, China. Her research inter- ests include anomaly detection in computer vision, machine learning, and deep learning. ZHAOXIANG LIU received the B.S. and Ph.D. degrees from the College of Information and Elec- trical Engineering, China Agricultural University, Beijing, China, in 2006 and 2011, respectively. He joined VIA Technologies Inc., Beijing, in 2011. From 2012 to 2016, he was a Senior Researcher with the Central Research Insti- tute, Huawei Technologies, Beijing. He was a Senior Manager of CloudMinds Technologies Inc., Beijing, from 2016 to 2019. Since 2019, he has been the Director of the AI Innovation and Application Center, China Uni- com Digital Technology Company Ltd., Beijing. His current research inter- ests include computer vision, deep learning, robotics, and human-computer interaction. SHIGUO LIAN (Member, IEEE) received the Ph.D. degree from the Nanjing University of Sci- ence and Technology, China. He was a Research Assistant with the City University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong, in 2004. From 2005 to 2010, he was a Research Scien- tist with France Telecom Research and Develop- ment Beijing, Beijing, China. He was a Senior Research Scientist and the Technical Director of the Huawei Central Research Institute, Beijing, from 2010 to 2016. He was the Senior Director of CloudMinds Technologies Inc., Beijing, from 2016 to 2019. Since 2019, he has been the Chief AI Scientist of China Unicom Digital Technology Company Ltd., and the Gen- eral Manager of the AI Innovation and Application Center, China Unicom Digital Technology Company Ltd., Beijing. He has authored or coedited over ten books. He holds over 50 patents. He has authored over 80 refereed international journal articles covering the topics of artificial intelligence, multimedia communication, and human-computer interface. Dr. Lian is on the editor board of several refereed international journals.
